title: Three unrelated topics: a typo fix, a real perf optimization, and a postponed feature request
notes: Long session spanning three unrelated topics: a trivial typo-fix decision, a real performance optimization decision, and a postponed feature request explicitly deferred, not built. Tests per-topic attribution and correct handling of a deferred item.

turns.text: Small thing first — the button on the settings page says 'Save Prefrences', missing the 'e'. Fix that?
Fixed the typo — 'Save Prefrences' is now 'Save Preferences' in the settings page component.

Thanks. Bigger thing — the /api/search endpoint is doing a full table scan on every request because there's no index on the searchable `title` column. It's the slowest endpoint we have, averaging 1.8s.

Confirmed via EXPLAIN ANALYZE — full sequential scan on a 2.1M-row table for every search. Adding a GIN index on a to_tsvector(title) expression would let Postgres use full-text search instead of scanning every row, and should bring average latency down substantially since it turns an O(n) scan into an index lookup.
Do it, and switch the query to use it.
Added the GIN index and rewrote the query to use to_tsvector(title) @@ to_tsquery(...) via the new index. Re-ran the same search queries: average latency dropped from 1.8s to about 90ms.
Great. Unrelated — a few users have asked if they can export their search history as CSV. Worth building now?

I wouldn't build it now — it's a nice-to-have with only a handful of requests so far, and there's no urgent business need driving it. I'd log it as a feature request and revisit if demand grows, rather than spending time on it in this session.
Logged as a deferred feature request: CSV export of search history, not being built at this time.

gold_atoms.text: Fixed a typo on the settings page: the button text 'Save Prefrences' was corrected to 'Save Preferences'.
The /api/search endpoint was doing a full sequential scan on a 2.1M-row table on every request because there was no index on the searchable title column, averaging 1.8s per request.
Add a GIN index on a to_tsvector(title) expression and rewrite the search query to use Postgres full-text search via that index, instead of a full table scan.
After adding the GIN index, average /api/search latency dropped from 1.8s to about 90ms.
CSV export of search history was requested by a few users but explicitly deferred, not built, due to low demand and no urgent business need — logged as a feature request to revisit if demand grows.
